claims: The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony takes place on Friday, April 17, 2026.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony takes place at Dolby Live at Park MGM in Las Vegas.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony takes place during WrestleMania 42 weekend.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony is headlined by Stephanie McMahon and AJ Styles.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony will be hosted by Michael Cole and The Miz.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony streams live on ESPN+ via the ESPN App in the U.S.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony streams live on YouTube internationally.
The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony streams at 12 a.m. ET.
Stephanie McMahon is a headliner inductee in the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame.
AJ Styles is a headliner inductee in the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame.
Demolition (Ax and Smash) are inductees in the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame.
Dennis Rodman is a celebrity inductee in the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame.
Sid Eudy is a legacy inductee in the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame.
Bad News Brown is a legacy inductee in the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame.
The Immortal Moment Award is for the WrestleMania III match between Hulk Hogan and Andre the Giant.
The Undertaker is set to induct Stephanie McMahon.
Men's Journal and ESPN report that the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony starts April 17 at 9 p.m. PT (Midnight ET).
